objective: All existing full-database evaluation configurations: custom exact search no slower than fastest measured Faiss path
pass_rule: Every configuration and each of 3 disjoint unseen query batches: median(custom) / min(median of all applicable Faiss controls) <=1.0 and correctness passes. SIFT controls: default, direct, BLAS, exact QT_8bit_direct; GloVe controls: default, direct, BLAS. No post-hoc tolerance. Finite measured criterion, not a universal guarantee.
constraints: No BLAS or Faiss calls in custom search
Preserve exact-search target and existing SIFT/float validation policies
Same single-thread affinity and timing boundaries
Freeze implementation before confirmation; changes invalidate that confirmation
Preprocessing remains outside query timings with costs recorded, consistently for all methods
revision_reason: Before any final confirmation, add exact-byte Faiss SQ8 direct control to match the new lossless representation; exclude all training query IDs from confirmation. Same 26 configs, 3 disjoint batches, 7 repeats and <=1 median-ratio criterion.
